import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2019_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',data)
patterns=['long-term debt','debt at year-end','year-end debt','long-term borrowings','debt']
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=str(t.get('text',''))
    low=txt.lower()
    if any(p in low for p in patterns):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',txt[:300].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
